limitations: This is a byte-identical immutable archive of the live canonical coverage immediately before the MP2K note-allocator promotion.
The snapshot proves only the frozen pre-promotion coverage identity; it does not classify any additional ROM bytes by itself.
After the promotion is accepted, this archive remains the replay input for the MP2K artifact and does not replace the live post-promotion coverage file.

recovery.serialization: Canonical source bytes compressed with gzip -n -9; decompression is byte-identical to the source.
